new_claim.statement: If an arbitrary ambient symmetric A has an ORIGINAL-coordinate principal block B of exact rank three whose three nonzero eigenvalues have modulus at least s, then the full ambient quadratic form is paid at <=12/s with continuity when the block frame has max leverage <=1/2; at <363/s when a heavy row has zero pivot or a transverse-heavy companion; and at <=256sqrt(2)/s when a heavy pivot has magnitude >=s/32. The only remaining state inside such a core is a heavy row with 0<|B_ii|<s/32 and all rerooted transverse leverages <=1/2. Outside spectrum/couplings are arbitrary and are removed only by genuine original-coordinate conditioning.

designated_partner_result_applied.application: Conditioning on outside ORIGINAL coordinates leaves the exact rank-three principal block and only creates deterministic affine terms. Scaling by s gives the partner hypotheses, yielding actual full-ambient bounds <363/s in the double-heavy and exact-null branches.

source_valid_transfer.claim: For a full-row-rank k x m map L on independent cap-one coordinates, ||p_(LX)||_infinity <= 2^(k/2)/sqrt(det(LL^T)). For a residual rank-three Parseval frame after deleting row u_i, this gives 2sqrt(2)/sqrt(1-c_i), and the whitened residual projection has density cap <=2sqrt(2).
source_valid_transfer.warning: Do not feed this bare joint density cap into the refuted arbitrary-joint indefinite coarea bound.
